beats.say: 75 percent off: Resident Evil Village now competes with Halloween The Game at nine dollars ninety nine.
Most gamers expected standard seasonal discounts across major digital stores this October.

Instead PC Gamer reports the price was slashed by 75 percent on Steam for spooky season, bringing the flagship horror title down to nine dollars ninety nine and putting it head to head with the brand new Halloween The Game which launched in September on PlayStation five, Xbox and PC.
The discount arrives just as the new horror game launches, giving players a cheaper alternative for the spooky season.
